name: Spitting Daffodil
disable: DC 25 Thievery check (expert) or DC 25 Survival check (trained) to remove the plant's motion sensing filaments
reset: The daffodils replenish their nectar and filaments after 24 hours.

items.name: Spit Nectar
items.text:
Trigger A non-plant creature comes within 10 feet

---

Effect The daffodils spit nectar at all non-plant creatures within 10 feet, dealing 4d8+18 acid damage (DC 27 basic Reflex save save).

text: Daffodils spit acidic nectar at non-plant creatures in the area.
